explanation: The Yongle Emperor finished his palace in 1420, nearly a century before Michelangelo completed the chapel ceiling. Emperors ruled from it until the Qing dynasty fell in 1912.

claims.text: The Forbidden City in Beijing was completed in 1420, under the Ming Yongle Emperor.
Michelangelo completed the Sistine Chapel ceiling in 1512.
Chinese emperors ruled from the Forbidden City until the Qing dynasty ended in 1912.
